panels.title: Usage · last 5 h
panels.description: Cost (cost_usd) per Claude account over the last 5 hours. Bar = that cost as % of the account's peak: its highest rolling 5-hour cost over the last 30 days (10-minute steps). Green below 60 %, yellow from 60 %, red from 80 %. Fixed windows: ignores the dashboard time range and the variables. Accounts with no cost in 7 days are not listed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    concat(if(t.label = '', '(no account)', t.label), '  ·  $', toString(round(t.h5, 2))) AS name,
    round(100 * t.h5 / greatest(p.peak, t.h5, 0.000001)) AS pct
FROM
(
    SELECT account_uuid,
           argMax(account, ts) AS label,
           sumIf(cost_usd, ts >= now() - INTERVAL 5 HOUR) AS h5,
           sumIf(cost_usd, ts >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS d7
    FROM cc.api_requests
    WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
    GROUP BY account_uuid
) AS t
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT account_uuid, max(w) AS peak
    FROM
    (
        SELECT account_uuid,
               sum(c) OVER (PARTITION BY account_uuid ORDER BY b RANGE BETWEEN 17999 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS w
        FROM
        (
            SELECT account_uuid, toUInt32(toStartOfInterval(ts, INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)) AS b, sum(cost_usd) AS c
            FROM cc.api_requests
            WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
            GROUP BY account_uuid, b
        )
    )
    GROUP BY account_uuid
) AS p ON p.account_uuid = t.account_uuid
WHERE t.d7 > 0
ORDER BY t.h5 DESC, t.d7 DESC

panels.title: Tips · 7 d
panels.description: Number of tips (view cc.tips, last 7 days). Click the value to open the Tips section of the Efficiency dashboard. Ignores the dashboard time range and the variables.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS tips
FROM cc.tips

panels.description: The most frequent tip category (view cc.tips, last 7 days) with its count in brackets (ties: alphabetical order). Click the value to open the Tips section of the Efficiency dashboard. Ignores the dashboard time range and the variables.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(tips = 0, 'none', concat(multiIf(top = 'cache', 'Cache rebuilds', top = 'repeated-read', 'Repeated reads', top = 'big-results', 'Big tool results', top = 'short-opus', 'Short Opus answers', top = 'agent-outlier', 'Costly agent run', top = 'denials', 'Denied tool calls', top = 'slow-hook', 'Slow hooks', top = 'slow-ttft', 'Slow first token', top), ' (', toString(n), ')')) AS most_frequent
FROM
(
    SELECT sum(c) AS tips,
           argMin(category, (-toInt64(c), category)) AS top,
           max(c) AS n
    FROM (SELECT category, count() AS c FROM cc.tips GROUP BY category)
)

panels.title: Tool events from tool_result and tool_decision. File paths come from the tool parameters.
panels.description: Every panel follows the time range and the Account, Project, Session, Actor and Skill variables. The rail on the left ignores them.

panels.title: Tool calls
panels.description: Number of tool calls (tool_result events) in the time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS calls, 'tool_result events' AS name
FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: Share of tool calls that failed (tool_result with success = false; a rejected call counts as failed). Below 2 % green, 2 % and above yellow, 5 % and above red, as on Overview.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 100 * countIf(NOT success) / greatest(count(), 1) AS error_rate, 'tool_result success = false' AS name
FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Rejected
panels.description: Tool calls that were rejected (tool_decision events with decision = reject), split by who rejected them: config (permission rules), hook, user (rejected or not allowed in the prompt). The Actor and Skill variables are matched through the agent and the model request of the decision. Green with none, red from one.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS rejected, concat('config ', toString(countIf(source = 'config')), ' · hook ', toString(countIf(source = 'hook')), ' · user ', toString(countIf(source = 'user'))) AS name
FROM
(
    SELECT e.ts AS ts, e.account_uuid AS account_uuid, e.project AS project, e.session_id AS session_id, e.tool_name AS tool_name,
           if(startsWith(e.decision_source, 'user'), 'user', e.decision_source) AS source,
           if(e.agent_id = '', 'main', if(a.agent = '', 'agent?', a.agent)) AS actor, r.skill AS skill
    FROM cc.events AS e
    LEFT JOIN cc.agents AS a ON a.agent_id = e.agent_id
    LEFT JOIN cc.requests AS r ON r.request_id = e.request_id
    WHERE e.event = 'tool_decision' AND e.decision = 'reject' AND e.tool_name != '' AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
)
WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}')

panels.title: Median result size
panels.description: Median size of the result a tool returned to the model (tool_result_size_bytes, calls with a result only); the second line is the 95th percentile. The telemetry carries bytes, not tokens (about 4 bytes per token).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ifNotFinite(quantileIf(0.5)(result_bytes, result_bytes > 0), 0) AS median_bytes, concat('p95 ', formatReadableSize(ifNotFinite(quantileIf(0.95)(result_bytes, result_bytes > 0), 0))) AS name
FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Calls by tool
panels.description: The 7 tools with the most calls. Errors = failed calls / calls of the tool: below 2 % green, 2 % and above yellow, 5 % and above red, as in Error rate above.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT tool_name AS tool, count() AS calls, 100 * countIf(NOT success) / count() AS error_pct
FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 7

panels.title: Rejected tool calls
panels.description: Tool calls rejected (tool_decision events with decision = reject) per tool, project and who rejected them: config (permission rules), hook, user (rejected or not allowed in the prompt). Counts from 5 are red (the denials tip fires at 5 in 7 days). Target of the denials tip. The Actor and Skill variables are matched through the agent and the model request of the decision.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT tool_name AS tool, project, source, count() AS n
FROM
(
    SELECT e.ts AS ts, e.account_uuid AS account_uuid, e.project AS project, e.session_id AS session_id, e.tool_name AS tool_name,
           if(startsWith(e.decision_source, 'user'), 'user', e.decision_source) AS source,
           if(e.agent_id = '', 'main', if(a.agent = '', 'agent?', a.agent)) AS actor, r.skill AS skill
    FROM cc.events AS e
    LEFT JOIN cc.agents AS a ON a.agent_id = e.agent_id
    LEFT JOIN cc.requests AS r ON r.request_id = e.request_id
    WHERE e.event = 'tool_decision' AND e.decision = 'reject' AND e.tool_name != '' AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
)
WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}')
GROUP BY tool_name, project, source ORDER BY n DESC, tool_name LIMIT 50

panels.title: Files re-read within one session
panels.description: Files read more than twice in one session (Read tool calls), paths relative to the project. Size = mean size of the result; Repeat tokens = about size / 4 x (reads - 1): the tokens the repeated reads added (the telemetry carries bytes, 4 bytes per token is a rule of thumb). Sorted by Repeat tokens, 50 rows at most. Target of the repeated-read tip.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT path AS file, project, count() AS reads, round(avg(result_bytes)) AS size, round(avg(result_bytes) / 4 * (count() - 1)) AS repeat_tokens
FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND op = 'read' AND path != ''
GROUP BY session_id, project, path HAVING reads > 2
ORDER BY repeat_tokens DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Largest tool results
panels.description: The 50 biggest results returned to the model (tool_result_size_bytes); big results fill the context window. Target = the file path (relative to the project) or the first word of the Bash command; the telemetry has no other target and none is shown for other tools. From 1 MiB the size is red. Target of the big-results tip.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT tool_name AS tool, multiIf(bash_cmd != '', bash_cmd, path != '', path, '—') AS target, result_bytes AS size
FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND result_bytes > 0
ORDER BY result_bytes DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Bash by first word
panels.description: The 5 most frequent first words of Bash commands (git, docker, ...). Claude Code sends only the first word of a command, so this is not a count of repeated commands.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT bash_cmd AS command, count() AS calls
FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND tool_name = 'Bash' AND bash_cmd != ''
GROUP BY command ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 5

panels.title: Most edited files
panels.description: Files changed most often (Edit, MultiEdit, Write and NotebookEdit calls), paths relative to the project, with the number of sessions that changed them. Sorted by Edits, the top 5.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT path AS file, project, count() AS edits, uniqExact(session_id) AS sessions
FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND op = 'write' AND path != ''
GROUP BY project, path ORDER BY edits DESC LIMIT 5
